blurb: Cirque Climbing Gym offers indoor climbing with options for beginners and experienced climbers. They provide day passes, memberships, rental gear, and various climbing classes including beginner belay, lead climbing, and family climb time. Safety orientations and proficiency tests are required for certain activities like auto-belay and top-rope belaying.
